records.context: The demo dataset on HuggingFace ships a settings CSV per stage beside the images. They were written by an older spaCR, so some of what they name no longer exists -- structured-data names renamed, structured-data names removed with the feature they configured, structured-data names that were never settings at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.settings_pack#1
records.source: The demo dataset on HuggingFace ships a settings CSV per stage beside the images. They were written by an older spaCR, so some of what they name no longer exists -- keys renamed, keys removed with the feature they configured, keys that were never settings at all.
records.translation: Sýnigagnasafnið á HuggingFace fylgir stillingaskrá á CSV-sniði fyrir hvert þrep við hlið myndanna. Þær voru skrifaðar af eldri útgáfu spaCR, svo sumt af því sem þær nefna er ekki lengur til -- lyklar sem hafa fengið nýtt nafn, lyklar sem voru fjarlægðir ásamt eiginleikanum sem þeir stilltu, og lyklar sem voru aldrei stillingar yfirleitt.

records.context: An unset count shows every slot that exists, which is what this dialog did before the count reached it: better to offer a field too many than to hide one a run is using.

records.translation: Óstilltur fjöldi sýnir hvert hólf sem er til, eins og þessi gluggi gerði áður en fjöldinn náði til hans: betra er að bjóða einum reit of mikið en að fela reit sem keyrsla notar.
